metadata.title: PWP-001: Protein Extraction with Thermo Fisher Pierce RIPA / T-PER Lysis Reagents
metadata.purpose: Extract protein from cultured cells or tissue for BCA assay, SDS-PAGE, western blotting, ELISA, IP, or purification planning.
metadata.scope: Training/library SOP draft for RIPA-style mammalian cell lysis with T-PER tissue adaptation. Confirm the current manufacturer protocol, SDS, and local EHS rules before bench use.
beforeYouBegin: Choose lysis reagent based on downstream use: RIPA is useful for total protein/western, while IP Lysis Buffer or M-PER may be gentler for complexes or activity assays.
Keep samples and buffers cold and add inhibitors immediately before use.
Wash cells with cold PBS when compatible to remove culture medium, serum, and debris.
Plan aliquots to avoid repeated freeze-thaw cycles.

steps.action: Prepare cold lysis buffer with freshly added protease and phosphatase inhibitors.
steps.criticalNotes: Choose the lysis reagent according to sample type and downstream use; add inhibitors immediately before use.

steps.action: For adherent cells, place the plate on ice, wash with cold PBS, remove PBS, and add enough lysis buffer to cover the monolayer.
Scrape adherent cells thoroughly and transfer lysate to a pre-chilled microcentrifuge tube.

branches.condition: Use after s2 for adherent cells

steps.action: For cell pellets, resuspend the pellet completely in cold lysis buffer and mix by pipetting or gentle vortexing.
For tissue, weigh tissue, add T-PER or selected lysis reagent at the validated weight-to-volume ratio, and homogenize on ice.
Incubate lysate on ice depending on sample type and reagent.

parameters.rawText: Incubate lysate on ice for 5-30 minutes depending on sample type and reagent.

steps.action: Clarify lysate by centrifugation at high speed and cold temperature for the selected reagent/sample workflow.
Transfer the supernatant to a clean pre-chilled tube without disturbing the pellet.
Measure protein concentration using BCA or another compatible assay.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Confirm compatibility with BCA/Bradford, IP, ELISA, or activity assay before committing samples.

steps.action: Aliquot lysate and store it at -80 deg C, or proceed directly to SDS-PAGE, western blot, ELISA, IP, or purification.
steps.expectedResult: Aliquoted lysate stored or used in a downstream workflow.

troubleshooting.cause: Incomplete lysis, insufficient homogenization, or poor sample storage.
troubleshooting.solution: Increase lysis time within compatibility, homogenize better, and keep samples cold.
Clarify more thoroughly or shear gently if compatible.
Use fresh inhibitors and keep the workflow cold.

troubleshooting.cause: Detergent, reducing agent, salt, or inhibitor incompatibility.
troubleshooting.solution: Choose a compatible assay or dilute, dialyze, or clean up the sample.

safety: Wear a lab coat, gloves, and eye protection; treat biological lysates and relevant reagents according to local EHS rules.
Keep proteins and antibody complexes cold unless the selected assay requires a defined alternative temperature.
Clarify lysates before assays or binding steps to reduce clogging, background, and nonspecific binding.
